method: Every stem and option set was recomputed against its passage with SudachiPy through scripts/ingest/known_set.py (PassageGate) on a scratch COPY of db/corpus.sqlite, using the gating lesson's cumulative_known_set from the exported course leaves and the builder's own P1/P2/P3/P4 code paths from scripts/export/build_reading_comp_bank.py. Every question was answered from the passage text alone before the authored key was read. The five corrected rows were re-run through the same checks and pass P1, P2/P3, P4, the level rule and the shape guard.

verdicts.note: Key うみ is the only destination tied to ごぜん ([1]); the other three options are all destinations the passage names, so the learner has to attach the right time to the right place instead of string-matching. P4 clear, three distractors printed verbatim.
あね appears only at [2] (cinema) and [4] (shopping); each distractor pairs one correct item with one あね-less activity, so there is no second key.
Perspective flip あげる to もらう over [2] and [4]; both items reach いもうと, so えだけ and くつだけ are each half right and かばん is absent. Sound.
Negative item resolved by [2] bought against [3] 見ます only. All four options are printed verbatim, so P4 and the orthography-giveaway rule are both clear.
Only [3] expresses a wish; the photo is past, the work is finished and the train is never wished for. Key unique.

verdicts.problem: The pt-BR explanation asserts something false about the passage: nem estacao nem casa entram na cena, but the house does appear, at [4] いぬといえにかえった. The station is genuinely absent; the house is not. Stem, options and key are correct.

corrected.stem: おとこの人がいたのは、どこですか。
corrected.explanation: A segunda frase coloca o homem do lado de fora do parque; o interior do parque aparece só na proibição que ele faz, a estação não é citada em momento nenhum e a casa entra só no fim, quando os dois voltam.

verdicts.problem: Longshot distractor / form giveaway: the stem asks だれとだれ (who and who), which demands a pair, so option 3 おじだけ names one person and is eliminable on form alone, without reading the passage. The key and the explanation are correct. Minimal fix: drop とだれ from the stem so that all four options are coherent answers.

options: おくさんとおばあさん
corrected.explanation: A última fala confirma que o tio e a esposa dele são os dois médicos; a avó aparece só como dona da casa, e parar no tio sozinho ignora a resposta final.

verdicts.problem: Ambiguous key. カメラをもっている reads first as who has it on them, and that is speaker B, who is carrying the camera bag ([1] これはカメラのかばんです); the passage only settles OWNERSHIP ([5] いいえ、あにのです). Option 0 あなた is therefore defensible against the intended key あに. The stem is also far above the gating lesson: les:n5-perguntas-05 (26 grammar points, a copula-only stage whose own passage contains no verb and no を) teaches neither を nor 〜ている. Recasting the stem as a possession question removes both problems and matches the passage's own wording.

corrected.stem: カメラは、だれのですか。
corrected.explanation: Na última troca a pessoa nega que a câmera seja dela e diz que é do irmão mais velho; irmã e amigo não aparecem no diálogo.

verdicts.note: The A-or-B turn [2] and its answer [3] settle it; がっこう is printed too, so the learner has to read the reply rather than spot a place name.
All four time slots are real events in the text and two options are printed verbatim, so the learner has to attach かおをあらう to the right slot.
そこで at [3] resolves to the department store; the morning activities are at home and nothing is bought anywhere in the text.
はは at [2] is the only person in the passage, and the option says おかあさん, so the item is not a surface match. Key unique.
Four relative clauses, all printed verbatim, one labelled 学生 at [2]; the name-writers are five people the text never labels, so there is no second key. Exactly the lesson's own grammar point.
[4] is the only てはいけません in the notice; 名前を書く is なくてもいい, optional rather than forbidden, which is the intended trap and is correctly explained.
[2] gives both halves, 出さないで and かばんに入れて; option 0 is the exact opposite and neither わたす option is in the text.
Genuine inference item: the reason is [0] read against the obligation in [1]. 九時 is the study limit, not a departure, and the notebook is not lost.
[2] 一人で answers だれと in the standard JLPT way; no companion is named anywhere in the note.

verdicts.problem: The pt-BR explanation asserts something false about the passage: A ultima frase e a unica que fala de casa, but [4] いぬといえへかえります also names the house, and the row's own `about` cites it. Stem, options and key are correct.

corrected.stem: いえにかえってからするのは、どれですか。
options: こうえんをあるくこと
シャワーをあびること
corrected.explanation: A volta para casa está na penúltima frase e o banho na última; brincar com o cachorro, caminhar e passear acontecem todos no parque, antes disso.

verdicts.note: The order in the text is homework, composition, homework ends, then the walk, so only しゅくだいのあと holds; breakfast is absent.

verdicts.problem: Aspect the passage does not state, written in a form the lesson has not taught. The passage says おんなのこがうたをうたいます (non-past), while the stem asks しているのは and all four options are 〜ています, asserting a progressive the text never marks; and les:n5-verbos-05 (Existencia com が: ある e いる, 38 grammar points) has no gram:te-iru in its cumulative known set, which first appears at les:n5-te-form-03, several modules later. The original also pairs a 〜のは stem with finite 〜ます options, which do not compose. Recasting stem and options in plain form plus こと fixes all three and keeps P4 clear: うたをうたいます is a verbatim span of the passage, so a 〜ます option set would be dropped by P4, while うたをうたうこと is not. Key, distractor logic and explanation are correct and unchanged.

corrected.stem: おんなのこがするのは、どれですか。
options: こうえんをあるくこと
corrected.explanation: A quarta frase atribui o canto à menina; o cachorro e a árvore aparecem só como coisas que existem no parque, sem ninguém interagindo com eles.

verdicts.note: The two ください requests are [1] and [5]; the magazine and the fruit are what gets bought, not what is asked of the mother.

summary: 21 reviewed: 16 pass, 5 carry a supplied correction, 0 unsalvageable. All 21 already clear the four coded builder rules, the W17 level rule (every kanji in every stem and option is inside les:n5-kanji-exame-03's 103), the shape guard and the provenance flags, and all 21 keys are answerable from the passage; exactly one key (perguntas-05) is ambiguous. The five corrections are two Japanese defects (perguntas-05's ambiguous もっている key, verbos-05's progressive aspect the passage does not state), one distractor eliminable on form alone (perguntas-04, だれとだれ against おじだけ), and two pt-BR explanations that assert something false about their own passage (passado-05 and verbos-03 both deny a house the text names).
notes_for_the_campaign: The cumulative_known_set GRAMMAR lists cannot serve as a gate and were deliberately not used as one here. The applied passages themselves routinely use grammar outside their gating lesson's list: the les:n5-verbos-03 passage uses へ, に, で and と while that lesson's set contains none of them, and the les:n5-passado-04 passage uses the て-form and 〜たい while that set contains neither. Only kanji and vocab are modelled. verbos-05 was flagged anyway because there the untaught form (〜ている, first taught at les:n5-te-form-03) also misstates the passage's aspect, which is a content defect rather than a sequencing one.

だけ appears in the options of particulas-lugar-07, perguntas-04 and verbos-06 without being in those lessons' grammar lists or in their passages, and こと as a nominaliser is in no lesson's vocab set in this file, passing only through the kana carve-out (rotina-04, te-form-05, verbos-03, and the verbos-05 correction). Both are house habits of the batch rather than per-row errors, and both are invisible to the builder.

Seven items are cloze-shaped: the stem restates one passage sentence with the answer replaced by a question word (particulas-lugar-05, particulas-lugar-08, passado-05, perguntas-06, rotina-03, te-form-04, and perguntas-05 after correction). None is rejectable, because in each one at least one distractor is also printed verbatim, so the learner has to pick the right sentence rather than match a single string. It is still the weakest shape in the batch and worth watching at N4/N3, where longer passages can carry inference.
